title: Causality-guided Prompt Learning for Vision-language Models via Visual Granulation
caption: Figure 3. Architecture of attribute disentanglement module, which contains two encoders Es, Ed to extract non-individualized and individualized attribute representation si, di from the visual fea- ture xi respectively, and a BBDM-based network. The upper fea- ture transfer process of BBDM is the diffusion process, which gen- erates latent features z0, ..., zT . The lower one is the reverse pro- cess, which generate reconstructed features ˆzT , ..., ˆz0 gradually, Tθ is a learnable transfer model, and LA is the training loss.
